summary: Cybin Inc., operating commercially as Helus Pharma (Nasdaq/TSX: HELP), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 9, 2026, announcing CEO Michael Halstead's participation in a fireside chat at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference in New York on September 14, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. EDT. The filing is a routine investor-conference notice with a webcast and replay; no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed. No special-situation event; no risk-arb angle arises, and no deal terms are stated.
